'''Ruthic''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] elder who was the head of the [[Tulpaa]] tribe. At some point, Ruthic released the former [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] court magician [[Raspir]] from a [[Mind prison|Rakatan mind trap]].

==Biography==
Ruthic was a warrior [[Priest/Legends|priestess]] who hailed from [[Tulpaa]] in the [[Rakatan Archipelago]]. While the rest of her [[Rakata/Legends|species]] had lost their connection to the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] millennia prior, her connection had been growing with each passing year. This unique development gave Ruthic great insight into the inner workings of the technology of her [[Infinite Empire/Legends|ancestors]]. She realized that the generations before her had failed to use the power available to them and was determined to uncover every lost secret. Hoping to better understand her fluke [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], Elder Ruthic ordered her priests to dissect healthy slaves to determine where the Force lies in the body.<ref name=":0">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

Ruthic became the leader of the Tulpaa tribe by exiling the former leaders into a [[Mind prison|mind trap]]. She dispatched hundreds of [[skipship]]s to scour the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] for [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and resources to aid in the construction of a [[Star Forge (Tulpaa)|new Star Forge]] above the skies of Tulpaa. Ruthic was advised on how to bend the Star Forge to her will by [[Raspir]], a [[Sith (species)/Legends|pure-blooded Sith]] court magician of [[Adas|King Adas]] who had been released from a mind prison when Ruthic banished her opponents to the same device.<ref name=":0" />

==Personality and traits==
Elder Ruthic was a priest with the skills of a warrior. She was ambitious and cruel, but was also very bright and not given to anger or excess. She craved knowledge on the Force and the lost secrets of her ancestors.<ref name=":0" />

Ruthic was fluent in many Unknown Region languages such as [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Minnisiat/Legends|Minnisiat]], [[Rakata (language)|Rakata]], [[Rammocate]], [[Sy Bisti/Legends|Sy Bisti]], and [[Vagaari (language)|Vagaari]].<ref name=":0" />

She wore ceremonial garb, wielded a ceremonial staff, and wore ceremonial gloves that doubled as combat gloves.<ref name=":0" />
